chunks: Al-Ḥalabī asked Abā ʿAbdِ اللَّهِ عليه السلام about the sick person: does he make up the prayers when he has been rendered unconscious? So he said:
No, except for the prayer during which he regained consciousness.

key_terms.الْمَرِيضِ: the sick person under discussion in the ruling
key_terms.يَقْضِي: to make up an act of worship after its time has passed

ai.seo_question: Does a person who was unconscious have to make up missed salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding a sick person who loses consciousness. It states that missed prayers during the state of unconsciousness are not to be made up, except for the prayer time in which the person regains consciousness.
